translations.web: The Son of Man indeed goes, as it has been determined, but woe to that man through whom he is betrayed!”
translations.bsb: Indeed, the Son of Man will go as it has been determined, but woe to that man who betrays Him.”
translations.kjv: And truly the Son of man goeth, as it was determined: but woe unto that man by whom he is betrayed!
translations.asv: For the Son of man indeed goeth, as it hath been determined: but woe unto that man through whom he is betrayed!
